# Unofficial Touying Slide Theme for Linköping University

An unofficial slide theme for Linköping University, mimicking the official keynote template (hence the name, nyckel is the swedish word for key).


## Usage
Use `typst init @preview/touying-liu-nyckel` to create a new project with this theme.

```console
$ typst init @preview/touying-liu-nyckel
Successfully created new project from @preview/touying-liu-nyckel:<latest>
To start writing, run:
> cd touying-liu-nyckel
> typst watch main.typ
```
